rules: Use one primary button per unequal action group; use secondary buttons when actions have equal weight.
Use native entity selects for users, roles, mentionables, and channels; use string select for bounded authored choices.
Use Label around modal inputs; Action Row with modal Text Input is deprecated.
Use a modal for structured input, not for information that could remain in the message.
Expose Components V2 attachments through File or Media Gallery; plain attachments do not display automatically.
Never simulate animation by noisy message spam; edit one owned status surface at meaningful state changes.
